About us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable. 

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices.  With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search. 

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

  • Leverage best practices to guide customer strategy and future growth for Insider One by cultivating customer affinity with Insider One solutions that drive impact for the customer.

    • What You Will Need:
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in consultative/complex technical deployment projects, architecture, design, implementation, and/or support of highly distributed applications.
  • Proven track record of building deep technical relationships with senior IT executives in large or highly strategic accounts.
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to orchestrate, lead, and influence virtual teams, ensuring the successful implementation of customer projects.
  • Extensive technical experience with cloud and hybrid infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, and technology management.
  • Familiarity, awareness, or strong working knowledge of development methodologies and technologies in one or more of the following: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS; REST, XML, database technologies.
  • You have strong product command and technical domain knowledge of one or more of the following: SaaS, Marketing, Mobile Applications, APIs, or Programming.
  • Strong communication skills in English and French.

    • What We Offer:
  • A chance to work in an international, diverse, and inclusive environment,
  • “Tech Talks” with famous and groundbreaking people from the software world,
  • To be part of an industry that’s shaping the future of customer experiences. Don't believe us? Just ask Google.
  • Access and opportunity to gain a limitless network all over the globe
  • Access to many hard and soft skills pieces of training to help you improve and challenge yourself.

data.description:
Global Services helps Chainalysis customers turn blockchain data and investigative tools into practical results. Our customers include law enforcement, national security teams, financial institutions, and organisations across the crypto industry.

We’re looking for a Deployment Strategist, Crypto Investigations, to join Global Services and support public-sector customers in France, particularly law enforcement and intelligence teams. You’ll use your investigative experience and technical skills to help customers get the most out of Chainalysis products. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role focused on investigations and practical problem-solving rather than software engineering.

You’ll work with customers throughout their engagement with Chainalysis, from understanding their needs and conducting investigations to developing workflows, delivering training, and helping them build their own capabilities. You’ll need sound investigative judgement, strong French communication skills, and the ability to build trusted relationships with customers.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Support customer engagements from initial discovery and pre-sales through investigations, solution delivery, training, and ongoing support

  • Conduct blockchain investigations using Chainalysis products, particularly Reactor

  • Work with law enforcement, intelligence, and other public-sector customers to understand their objectives and help them achieve practical results

  • Build and adapt investigative workflows, queries, reports, and dashboards using Chainalysis tools and data

  • Help customers put investigative workflows into practice and develop the skills to use Chainalysis independently

  • Build trusted customer relationships by providing practical investigative guidance and product expertise

  • Lead customer meetings, demonstrations, investigative walkthroughs, training sessions, and technical briefings

  • Support pre-sales discussions by understanding customer requirements and explaining how Chainalysis can help

  • Share customer feedback and investigative insights with Product, Engineering, Global Intel, and Sales

  • Share investigative techniques and best practices with colleagues across Global Services

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Experience conducting or supporting investigations in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, or a related field. Candidates with relevant crypto or financial-crime investigation experience from other backgrounds will also be considered

  • Experience working with public-sector, law-enforcement, intelligence, or other mission-focused stakeholders

  • Strong investigative judgement and the ability to explain findings clearly and build credibility with customers

  • The technical aptitude to learn investigative platforms and work with data; extensive software-engineering experience is not required

  • The ability to analyse complex information and communicate findings to both investigators and senior stakeholders

  • The flexibility to work across pre-sales, customer delivery, and ongoing support

  • Fluency in French, with the ability to work confidently with French-speaking customers

  • The ability to be based in France, ideally in Paris

Required Skills

Technical Skills

  • Confidence using investigative tools and the ability to develop expertise in Chainalysis Reactor

  • Ability to work with investigative data and turn customer requirements into practical workflows, queries, and reports

  • Familiarity with blockchain investigation tools or analytical workflows is an advantage; Python and SQL are not required

  • Ability to learn Chainalysis products and understand how their data can support customer investigations

Domain Expertise

  • Experience in law enforcement, policing, intelligence, financial crime, or another relevant investigative field

  • Understanding of investigative objectives, operational workflows, and the outcomes customers need to achieve

  • Ability to use investigative judgement to guide an investigation and advise customers on their approach

Customer & Communication Skills

  • Ability to build trusted customer relationships through investigative knowledge and practical support

  • Excellent spoken and written French, including the ability to explain complex investigative concepts clearly

  • Confidence leading customer meetings, briefings, demonstrations, and training sessions

  • Ability to help customers develop their own skills and use Chainalysis tools independently

Day to Day Activities

  • Conduct investigations using Chainalysis tools, primarily Reactor, based on customer requirements

  • Prepare investigative reports, workflows, queries, and other analytical outputs

  • Work directly with customers to develop and implement investigative workflows

  • Deliver hands-on training, walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions

  • Lead demonstrations, investigative briefings, and solution presentations

  • Support pre-sales discussions, technical discovery, and solution scoping

  • Gather customer feedback and share practical recommendations with Product, Engineering, and Global Intel

  • Manage multiple customer engagements while maintaining quality and responsiveness

  • Continue developing knowledge of blockchain investigations and emerging crypto-related threats

Personal Attributes

  • Curious about blockchain technology, crypto crime, and investigative techniques

  • Able to communicate clearly and adapt to different audiences

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making sound decisions in situations where the path forward may not be clear

  • Collaborative and willing to work across teams

  • Keen to develop specialist knowledge and share it with others

Nice to have experience: [icing on the cake, not a deal breaker]

  • Previous experience using Chainalysis products

  • Experience with cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain analytics, or financial-crime analysis

  • Experience in traditional finance or financial investigations

  • Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, or the Travel Rule

  • Experience with data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or cloud-based analytics tools

  • Published research, intelligence reports, or other work relating to blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s presales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA.

Sales Cycle Ownership & AE Partnership

  • Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

  • Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

  • Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

  • Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

  • Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

Demo Excellence

  • Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objection handling, and industry playbooks, brought to life directly in Synthesia's platform.

  • Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface.

Product Expertise

  • Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value.

  • Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp.

  • Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

  • Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

  • Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience).

  • Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell).

  • Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer's use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires.

  • Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned.

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect.

  • Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization.

  • Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly.

  • Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines.

  • Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed.

We'd be particularly excited if

  • You speak Spanish and Italian

Location

We’re ideally looking for someone based in Paris who can spend time in our office at 40 Rue du Colisée, 75008 Paris, or someone based in the UK who can spend time in our London office at 20 Triton Street, Regent’s Place, London NW1 3BF. Please confirm where you are located and whether you can spend two days a week in either location.

Vos missions

  • Définir la stratégie concurrentielle de la région et tenir les parties prenantes seniors informées de l'avancement

Vous êtes fait pour ce poste si…

  • Expérience dans la construction d'une région ou d'un territoire commercial dès ses débuts, avec la structure nécessaire pour le faire évoluer

  • Prise de décision stratégique et orientée données, avec la capacité à diriger dans l'incertitude d'un marché en forte croissance

Pourquoi rejoindre SumUp

🌎 Opportunité de travailler avec des SumUppers du monde entier sur des produits fintech à grande échelle utilisés par des millions d'entreprises, dans le cadre d'un poste de terrain couvrant la région de Toulouse. Ce poste implique des déplacements réguliers pour accompagner votre équipe sur le territoire 🌈 Engagement envers la diversité et l'inclusion : faites partie d'un environnement de travail qui valorise et promeut la diversité, favorisant un cadre inclusif où les perspectives de chacun sont respectées et accueillies 🚀 Adhésion à notre programme d'options d'achat d'actions virtuelles (VSOP) : vous détiendrez une participation dans le succès futur de SumUp 📚 Un budget annuel dédié de 2000 € pour votre développement personnel, utilisable pour assister à des conférences et/ou faire progresser votre carrière grâce à une formation complémentaire 💼 Sécurité financière : des cotisations de retraite d'entreprise qui soutiennent votre avenir à long terme 🏥 Accompagnement santé : nous prenons en charge 50 % du coût mensuel de votre assurance santé (Mutuelle et Prévoyance) 🚌 Avantages supplémentaires : nous proposons des titres restaurant (Swile) et prenons en charge vos frais de transport 🏖 Congés généreux : profitez de 25 jours de congés payés, ainsi que des jours fériés et des jours de congés spéciaux 🎉 Petits déjeuners réguliers, événements d'équipe, fêtes de bureau et activités sportives 🌴 Break4me : un mois sabbatique après 3 ans d'ancienneté 🔗 Prime de cooptation : bénéficiez de récompenses supplémentaires en recommandant des talents pour rejoindre l'équipe SumUp

À propos de SumUp

Soyez acteur d'un changement qui compte vraiment.

Chez SumUp, notre mission est d'accompagner les petites entreprises du monde entier en leur proposant des outils simples et accessibles qui leur permettent de prospérer. Aujourd'hui, plus de 4 millions d'entreprises dans 39 marchés font confiance à SumUp comme partenaire financier pour gérer leurs paiements, leurs finances et leurs relations clients.

Notre engagement envers les petites entreprises se reflète dans notre équipe diversifiée de plus de 4 000 SumUppers originaires de plus de 90 nationalités, unis par une collaboration mondiale et un esprit innovant. Nos valeurs fondamentales constituent le socle de notre identité et de nos convictions, façonnant notre culture de travail et portant notre réussite. Nous cultivons l'inclusion et une culture d'apprentissage continu, en offrant un espace sûr pour l'épanouissement personnel et professionnel. Votre rôle

Au sein de notre département R&D, vous rejoignez l’équipe Studio, en charge du développement de notre outil de conception et de configuration d’entrepôts robotisés.

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation de niveau Bac+5 en informatique ou en informatique industrielle, et justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en développement web.

data.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

As Yubo continues to scale, Machine Learning is becoming a core production layer, powering critical systems across safety, recommendations, and product optimization.

What makes this role unique is both the scale and diversity of our data, and the level of maturity we are aiming to reach.

We process massive volumes of images, text, and real-time user interactions, across millions of users worldwide, creating a wide range of high-impact ML challenges, including:

  • Content moderation (image, text, behavior)

  • Recommendation systems and user engagement optimization

  • Behavioral detection and trust & safety models

  • Emerging use cases such as dynamic pricing and growth optimization

At the same time, our current ML stack is still evolving.
Legacy models are not fully integrated into pipelines, lifecycle management remains inconsistent, and our approach can sometimes resemble “develop, deploy, and forget.”

As ML usage expands across the company, this creates increasing complexity and dependency on reliable, well-structured systems.

There is still a huge amount of untapped potential, with many ML use cases yet to be designed, tested, and scaled, but unlocking it requires building a more robust and scalable ML operating model.

We are therefore looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael (Head of Platform Engineering).

About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

Our clinical-prediction offer gives pharma partners the evidence to guide decisions before and during clinical development. We are looking for a Scientific Product Director to turn this science into sellable products: decide what gets developed and when, define what each capability can claim and output, and shape how results are delivered to partners.

You will report to Gustave Ronteix, CTO and co-founder, and work daily with a tight-knit interdisciplinary team composed of Computational Biology, Data Science, R&D, Platform Strategy & Operations, BD and Pharma Partnerships.

What you'll do

1. Own the product roadmap

  • Design and build a scalable product capable of derisking and accelerating clinical development of drug candidates based on Orakl’s scientific capabilities

  • Turn signals from BD, Pharma Partnerships and R&D into capability definitions: specs, target metrics, validation plan, in- vs out-of-scope definition, cost to deliver

  • Set priorities and dates with Engineering and Data Science; flag slippage early and make the trade-offs

  • Identify productization-gaps from delivery audits and analysis, and feed recurring ones back into the roadmap

2. Oversee product maturity and decide what we sell

  • Maintain the capability catalog: what is available now, in beta or on the roadmap, and what each can and cannot claim

  • Contribute to the final decision of when a capability is ready to sell (based on Data Science’s validation evidence) versus what is not-yet sellable in the pipeline, and communicate it internally

  • Oversee the scientific case for each capability: white papers, application notes, posters

3. Design how results reach partners

  • Design the reports, data packages and dashboards partners receive, and direct the engineers who build them

  • Own the deliverable contents: figures, statistical summaries, methods, limitations

  • Embed the approved claims and the QC checklist in every template, so Pharma Partnerships can produce a correct deliverable at scale

  • Keep templates current as the validated envelope changes, and pull or revise one when it no longer applies

What we're looking for

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

IN SHORT

Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges.


YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.
  • Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.
  • Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.
  • Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet.
  • Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.
  • Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.
  • Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.
  • Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.
  • Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.

  • Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.
  • Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.
  • Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.
  • Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.
  • Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.
  • High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.
  • Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.
  • Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.

OUR BENEFITS

  • Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true

  • We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund

  • We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
  • Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing
  • Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions
 
Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.


ABOUT US

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality. 
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

You set clear expectations for execution methods, field quality controls, and turnover documentation needed for safe operation and maintenance.

  • System Reliability & Innovation: You lead initiatives to improve reliability and performance of Electrical systems, troubleshoot issues, and implement preventive measures. You evaluate and introduce emerging technologies such as energy efficiency solutions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: You act as the primary Electrical interface with process, instrumentation and controls, mechanical, and project management teams to ensure integrated designs. You identify and mitigate Electrical risks during design and operation phases and support project teams with scope, cost, and schedule estimates.

  • Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement: You supervise and coach junior team members, provide guidance on technical challenges, and drive lessons-learned sessions to maintain a strong knowledge base and promote continuous improvement.  You maintain thorough records of technical decisions, design bases, vendor information, and lessons learned for future operational use.

  • Cold-Weather and Constructability: As our next DAC plant could be in a cold or hot weather environment, you incorporate climate conditions into the Electrical design and execution planning (extreme heat, freeze protection, winterization, insulation/heat tracing philosophy, cold start/commissioning constraints). You ensure the design is constructable and able to operate and be maintained through cold or hot conditions, including consideration of temporary works, for instance winter work sequencing, and interface constraints with cold-weather activities.


  • Professional Experience: You have a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent and have at least 10 years of experience in process plants various climates as an Electrical Engineer.  You have experience leading teams.

  • Project Experience: You have hands-on involvement in at least one full-cycle project in the mining, water treatment, oil and gas or other comparable industries, covering all phases from FEED and detailed design to construction, commissioning and start-up; preferably in remote/seasonally constrained execution environments.  You have expertise in low and medium voltage electrical systems, industrial instrumentation, and control systems.

  • Cold-Weather Industrial Plant Experience: You have hands-on experience working with industrial plants in cold-weather environments (e.g. Canada, Nordic countries, or similar climates) and understand the operational, maintenance, and safety challenges associated with extreme weather conditions.

  • Communication & Collaboration: You demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills and can liaise with diverse stakeholders, including third-party vendors in IP-sensitive collaborations.

  • Working Style: You are precise, adaptable, and reliable, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach. You are comfortable driving decisions and owning them in the office and under field constraints, including winter productivity and schedule risk.  You are highly organized, able to plan and prioritize work for yourself and others, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments.

Die Rolle

Als Remote Ernährungsberater*in BSc (a) bietest du qualitativ hochwertige, digitale Ernährungsberatung für Patientinnen und Patienten im Rahmen unseres integrierten Gesundheit Ökosystems an.   • Qualität & Entwicklung: Regelmässiger Austausch mit deiner Teamleitung sowie Teilnahme an virtuellen Teammeetings und internen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Qualifikation: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Ernährungswissenschaften / Ernährungsberatung (FH oder Bachelor BFH / FFHS) oder eine entsprechende Schweizer SRK-Anerkennung eines ausländischen Diploms.

  • Digitale Affinität: Begeisterung für das Arbeiten im 100%igen Remote-Setting und Erfahrung mit digitaler Videokommunikation sowie der parallelen Nutzung verschiedener Software-Systeme.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Freude am täglichen, vertrauensvollen Austausch mit Patientinnen und Patienten sowie im interdisziplinären Team.

Was von Vorteil ist:

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung von Patientinnen und Patienten mit Adipositas und gewichtsbezogenen Erkrankungen (inkl. moderner Therapieformen wie GLP-1-Medikamenten).

  • Zusatzausbildung oder fundiertes Verständnis im Bereich Ernährungspsychologie.

  • Erfahrung in der digital unterstützten Gesundheitsversorgung (Digital Health).

Deine Benefits bei Oviva

  • Ein interessantes und abwechslungsreiches Aufgabengebiet mit gezielter Einarbeitung in einem innovativem Geschäftsumfeld (Digital Health)

  • Ein unbefristete Festanstellung mit viel Flexibilität bezüglich Arbeitszeit, -pensum und -ort sowie Möglichkeit im Home Office zu arbeiten

  • Ein dynamisches, aufgeschlossenes und humorvolles Team, welches gemeinsam Erfolge feiert und Wissen untereinander teilt

  • Eine innovative, eigenentwickelte Software zur Datenverwaltung und Dokumentation sowie Kommunikation mit deinen Patienten

  • Attraktive Benefits wie ein persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget, Kauf von zusätzlichen Ferientagen sowie fortschrittliche Konditionen bei der beruflichen Vorsorge

Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Dann bist Du bei Oviva genau richtig.

Warum Oviva?

Bei Oviva verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir wollen nachhaltige, personalisierte, klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich machen.

Die Stelle

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang

Menschen mit Adipositas sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patient*innen leiden zusätzlich unter psychischen oder neurodivergenten Herausforderungen wie ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depression, Angststörungen oder Binge-Eating-Störungen.
Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

Bei Oviva greifen wir Themen auf, die viele unserer Patient*innen beschäftigen – wie Selbstbild, hormonelle Veränderungen, Elternschaft, Belastung im Alltag oder emotionale Essmuster. In der Psychotherapie bei Oviva dürfen all diese Themen ihren Platz haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

Duties & Role: 

The Principal Technician (ICT Systems) is responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of information and communication technology systems. He/she provide technical support to end-users and troubleshoot any issues that arise. They stay up to date with the latest technology trends and make recommendations for system improvements. They handle tasks related to configuring hardware and software, managing computers and networks devices, troubleshooting technical issues, ensuring data security and system reliability, and provide technical support to end-users. They collaborate with various departments to understand their technology needs and optimize the organization's ICT infrastructure to support business operations efficiently.

Software configuration

System software

  • Monitors operational systems for resource usage and failure rates, to inform and facilitate system software tuning.

  • Installs and tests new versions of system software.
  • Contributes to preparation of software implementation procedures with fall back contingency plans.

Network support

  • Carries out agreed network maintenance tasks and specified operational configuration of network components.
  • Establish and diagnose network problems/faults using the required troubleshooting methodology and tools.
  • Uses network management software and tools to collect agreed performance and traffic statistics.

Systems installation and removal

  • Installs or removes hardware and/or software, using supplied installation instructions and tools, including handover to the client.

  • Contributes to the development of installation procedures and standards.

Release and deployment

  • Uses approved tools and techniques for specific deployment activities.
  • Administers the recording of activities, logging of results and documents technical activities undertaken.

The Principal Technician (ICT Systems) will provide 24/7 Immediate On-Call Response to the Service Operations with technical AirC2 expertise and solutions at Level 2 support with ticket response and resolutions that will meet current operational needs and defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

The Principal Technician (ICT Systems) will work as an on-site integrated member of the assigned service team, when not on 24/7 on-call duty for immediate ticket response and resolution. He will help with the design, development, test and on-site support of engineering changes to services, processes, organisation, operating model and other aspects. This effort may be required in addition to his/her daily service operations and maintenance tasks.

Desirable:

Expansion Intern | Austria or Netherlands

Internship · Full-time · Berlin or Amsterdam

 

Our mission for you

Take trawa beyond borders!

As an Expansion Intern, you'll play a key role in taking trawa into new markets and will experience hands-on what it means to be an operator. You'll work across go-to-market, operations and product, and see up close what it takes to bring a fast-growing energy platform into a new country. We are hiring on a rolling basis, minimum duration is 3 months.

Two markets, one mission:

  • Austria: trawa is already live here, and you'll help scale the market: speeding up growth, sharpening our local positioning and turning our Austrian presence into a success story.

  • The Netherlands: trawa is preparing its Dutch market entry, and you'll help lay the foundations from day one: understanding the market, positioning trawa, supporting our first sales and commercial activities, and preparing everything for launch.

We staff you on the market where your profile and our needs fit best. Either way, you'll build something that truly matters.

 
 

What you'll do, whichever market you work on:

  • Supercharge local go-to-market: You research competitors, help define how trawa wins in your market and support early customer acquisition. Your work directly drives our local growth.

  • Turn regulation into a competitive edge: Energy markets change constantly. You track legal and regulatory updates, work out what they mean for trawa and help us adapt faster than anyone else.

  • Build local operations: You support product rollouts, from contract frameworks to processes, and help adapt what works at our Berlin HQ to the local market.

  • Shape the product for new markets: You bring local customer and market insights into our product team and help make sure trawa fits the needs of businesses in your country.

  • Become the market expert: You run ad-hoc analyses, build market overviews and quickly become the go-to person for everything specific to your country.

  • Collaborate with leadership: You work closely with our expansion leads and senior leadership. You take ownership of your own initiatives and see them through from idea to execution.

  • You are a true team player: You understand that humility and performance go hand in hand, and that what counts is the overall success of the team.

 

Who we are looking for

Standout candidates who want to grow with us:

  • Advanced Bachelor's student, in your gap year, Master's student, or recent graduate with outstanding academic achievements.

  • You have a strong track record. Analytical skills, an entrepreneurial mindset and a high degree of independence set you apart.

  • You’re highly motivated, hands-on, and eager to take real responsibility.

  • You have first practical experience in a dynamic startup, top-tier strategy consultancy or investment banking.

  • You're curious about the energy transition and are not scared of legal texts.

Market-specific requirements:

  • Austrian team: You are fluent in English and German (C1 or higher), and you're based in or willing to move to Berlin.

  • Dutch team: You are fluent in English, German and Dutch are a plus, and you're based in or willing to move to Amsterdam.

 

Why us?

  • Your impact: Your work has a direct influence on how trawa grows across Europe, and you get to help shape a new market from the ground up.

  • Flexible working: We foster a vibrant company culture where we love to work together, and home office is also an option. With flexible working hours and 30 vacation days, we support your work-life balance.

  • Attractive benefits: In addition to a competitive salary, you'll receive lunch vouchers, a learning and development budget and an Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Diversity & inclusion: Everyone is welcome at trawa! We are committed to an inclusive workplace that values diversity. We actively encourage people of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnic backgrounds, and physical or neurodiverse abilities to apply.

  • Application process: You'll receive feedback within a week. The process includes interviews, a practical challenge and conversations with our team.

Don't worry if you don't meet every single requirement. If you're excited about the role and our mission, we want to hear from you!

 

About us

trawa is a fast-growing energy start-up that is revolutionizing the way businesses procure and manage their energy consumption and costs. Our mission is to make sustainable energy accessible and affordable for every business. We are seeking talented individuals who are passionate about making a positive impact and contributing to our shared success.

Do you get energy from winning new customers? Do you know how to build a pipeline from scratch, engage senior decision-makers and turn complex business challenges into successful deals?

At Yenlo, we are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive who knows how to create opportunities, not just manage them.

This is a true hunting role, with the opportunity to make a direct impact on Yenlo's growth. We have built a strong international business in Integration, API Management, Identity & Access Management and Managed Services. Now we are expanding into Data, AI, Automation and Control. We have the technology expertise, strong partnerships and delivery capabilities. What we need is someone who can bring us to the right table, create demand and win new business.

About Yenlo

Yenlo has helped organisations connect their business-critical systems and processes for more than 17 years. We do this with around 100 colleagues from over 18 nationalities, with offices in the Netherlands, Germany, Spain, Sri Lanka, the United States and Canada. We have been a WSO2 Platinum Partner since 2008 and a Boomi partner since 2015, and our customers include Boeing, Hard Rock Café and several ministries and universities. Now we are building on our integration expertise with Data, AI and Automation, so customers can bring their technology into production securely and reliably. For that, we are looking for someone who opens new markets.

What will you do?

As Enterprise Account Executive, your primary mission is to win new customers and build profitable, long-term business relationships.

You will focus on mid-market and enterprise organisations across the Benelux and DACH regions, particularly those facing complex challenges around applications, integration, data, cloud transformation and AI.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Win new logos and build your own pipeline. Identify target accounts, open doors and generate business through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and strategic partnerships.

  • Engage senior decision-makers and sell business value. Build relationships with CIOs, CTOs and other business and technology leaders, and translate their challenges into opportunities around Integration, Data, AI, Automation and Control.

  • Own the sales cycle. Lead opportunities from initial engagement through proposal, negotiation and closing, together with our solution architects, consultants and product specialists.

  • Help shape our go-to-market. Bring customer insights and market feedback into Yenlo to help us improve our propositions and commercial approach.

  • Deliver results. Take ownership of your pipeline, forecasts, new-business targets and the profitability of the deals you win.

You will have access to existing customer references, partner relationships and marketing support. But this is not a role where you inherit a ready-to-close pipeline or rely on an SDR team to fill your calendar. We expect you to create opportunities yourself and have the commercial drive to turn them into business.

What can you expect from Yenlo?

At Yenlo, you will join an international technology company with around 100 colleagues, strong technical expertise and ambitious plans for the future.

We offer:

  • Real ownership. A new-business role with the freedom to develop opportunities and make a visible commercial impact.

  • Attractive earning potential. A competitive fixed salary and a substantial performance-based bonus, with uncapped upside for overachievement.

  • A strong technology portfolio. Established capabilities in Integration, API Management, IAM and Managed Services, complemented by growing propositions in Data, AI and Control.

  • Access to specialists. Experienced solution architects, consultants and product teams to support discovery, demonstrations, assessments and proposals.

  • An international ecosystem. Partnerships with leading technology providers, including Boomi and WSO2, alongside Yenlo's own Connext platform.

  • Room to build. The opportunity to contribute to our evolving commercial approach, propositions and go-to-market strategy.

  • Professional benefits. Pension arrangements, holiday allowance, a lease car or mobility allowance, laptop and phone.

  • A realistic start. An appropriate ramp-up period, recognising that enterprise sales cycles take time and building a pipeline starts from day one.

You will work closely with our sales leadership and wider commercial organisation. We believe in face-to-face collaboration, both with customers and colleagues, and expect you to spend time at our Schiphol-Rijk office on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays.


We are looking for a commercially driven, entrepreneurial sales professional with a proven track record in complex B2B technology sales.

You know how to build relationships, navigate enterprise organisations and close significant deals.

What you bring:

  • A demonstrable track record of generating your own pipeline and personally closing new enterprise customers.

  • Experience selling complex IT services, software, cloud, integration or other enterprise technology solutions.

  • Experience managing six-figure deals and longer, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Strong outbound prospecting, consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills.

  • The ability to engage credibly with senior business and technology decision-makers.

  • Enough technical understanding to discuss Integration, APIs, Data and AI, while focusing on business outcomes rather than technical features.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and the resilience to succeed without a fully established sales playbook.

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with technical and commercial colleagues.

  • Professional proficiency in Dutch and English.

Experience with platforms such as Boomi, WSO2, MuleSoft, AWS, Azure or related enterprise technologies is an advantage, but not a requirement. An existing network in the Benelux or DACH enterprise market would be a strong plus. We care more about what you have personally achieved than the number of years on your CV or the technology companies you have worked for.

Ready to make an impact?

If you enjoy opening doors, creating opportunities and winning complex enterprise deals, we would love to meet you.

Over ons
 
Steeds meer mensen in Europa kiezen ervoor om zelfstandig te werken als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Zelfstandig werken biedt vrijheid en flexibiliteit om te bepalen wanneer, hoe en met wie je wilt werken. Het zien groeien van je eigen bedrijf kan zowel professioneel als financieel belonend zijn.
 
Zelfstandig zijn brengt echter ook onzekerheden met zich mee. De juiste verzekeringen zijn essentieel om voorbereid te zijn op de risico’s van het ondernemerschap.
 
Bij Insify bieden we transparante, flexibele en eerlijk geprijsde verzekeringen, afgestemd op de behoeften van ondernemers. Zo kunnen zij zich volledig richten op hun werk, in de wetenschap dat ze altijd op ons kunnen rekenen.
Insify verzekert duizenden klanten in heel Europa. Wij bieden betrouwbare verzekeringen zonder ingewikkeld papierwerk. Een verzekering bij Insify sluit je 100% digitaal af, vandaag geregeld is morgen verzekerd.
 
Hoe wij werken
 
Bij Insify hebben we vier kernwaarden: doorzettingsvermogen, impact, zorg en ondernemerschap. Die leggen we kort even uit:
Doorzettingsvermogen: We zijn niet bang voor uitdagingen en gaan juist door waar anderen stoppen.
Impact: We maken het verschil in het leven van onze klanten en belonen hun vertrouwen in ons. 
Zorg: Wij stellen onze klanten altijd centraal. Hun succes is ons doel.
Ondernemerschap: Innovatie zit in ons DNA. We gaan snel en we denken groot.  
 
Bij Insify word je onderdeel van een hecht team. Daarom werken we het liefst zo veel mogelijk op kantoor. Dat klinkt misschien raar voor een 100% online verzekeraar, maar wij geloven dat een sterke onderlinge band ons helpt sneller te innoveren en onze klanten nog beter te bedienen. Zo’n band is eigenlijk alleen via persoonlijk contact te realiseren.
Door regelmatig naar kantoor te komen, leren nieuwe collega’s bovendien sneller en voelen ze zich eerder thuis.
 
We begrijpen ook dat je misschien niet elke dag naar kantoor kunt komen of dat er momenten zijn dat je je focus nodig hebt. Daarom is gedeeltelijk thuiswerken in overleg mogelijk.
 
Operations Team
 
Wij zijn degenen die vertrouwen opbouwen bij elk contactmoment—of het nu om een verkoop, een supportgesprek of het afhandelen van een claim gaat. We zorgen ervoor dat prospects en klanten zich gesteund, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelen. Snelheid en kwaliteit zijn voor ons belangrijk, en we volgen onze voortgang nauwgezet zodat we blijven verbeteren. Met het oog op de toekomst bereiden we ons voor op medische acceptatie in 2025—een volgende stap om onze service nóg sterker te maken.

Jouw rol
 
Binnen Insify zijn we op zoek naar een ambitieuze werkstudent rechten die op zoek is naar een betekenisvolle bijbaan naast de studie. Een rol waarin juridische kennis direct wordt toegepast, klantcontact centraal staat en waardevolle ervaring wordt opgedaan die uitstekend aansluit bij een toekomstige juridische carrière.
 
Als werkstudent Claims & Legal Support ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten van Insify met een schade- of arbeidsongeschiktheidsclaim. Je combineert klantgerichtheid met juridische scherpte en zorgt ervoor dat onze klanten snel, eerlijk en zorgvuldig worden geholpen.
 
Je werkt nauw samen met onze Legal & Claims specialisten en denkt mee over complexe aansprakelijkheidskwesties en bezwaarprocedures. Jij zorgt dat onze belofte van snelle, heldere en menselijke service ook in de praktijk wordt waargemaakt.

Jouw profiel
  • Aanspreekpunt voor klanten. Je helpt klanten die schade melden of arbeidsongeschikt zijn geraakt. Je luistert, stelt de juiste vragen en begeleidt hen door het proces.
  • Claims behandelen. Je beoordeelt claims inhoudelijk en zorgt voor een efficiënte en correcte afhandeling, met oog voor zowel klant als organisatie.
  • Meedenken in complexe dossiers. Je ondersteunt bij lastige casussen, bijvoorbeeld rond aansprakelijkheid of bij het opstellen van reacties op bezwaren.
  • Samenwerken met Legal. Je schakelt met het juridische team bij ingewikkelde vraagstukken en werkt mee aan het verder verbeteren van interne processen
  • Een tweede of derdejaars bachelorstudent of een masterstudent Verzekeringsrecht of Nederlands Recht heeft onze voorkeur. 
  • Goede beheersing van zowel de Engels als Nederlandse taal. 
  • Beschikbaar voor minimaal 2 of 3 dagen per week voor minimaal 6 maanden; 
    • Wat wij bieden
     
    Concurrerende vergoeding - We willen de besten aantrekken en behouden, daarom bieden we een compensatiepakket dat daarbij past.
    Pensioenregeling - Deelname aan Insify’s pensioenplan, met 6% werkgeversbijdrage.
    Reiskostenvergoeding - We helpen reizigers met hun woon-werkverkeer.
    Hybride werken - Mogelijkheid om twee keer per week vanuit huis te werken. Als ervaren professional kun je remote werken en kom je af en toe naar kantoor.
    25 vakantiedagen per jaar - (+ een extra dag op kerstavond als het een werkdag is!)
    Abonnement op Alleo - 50 EUR (netto) maandelijks (op te sparen) budget om uit te geven aan wat je wilt - van sportschoolabonnementen tot UberEats!
    Leuke events - Maandelijkse team drinks, kwartaal uitjes, lunch & learns, feesten, merch en FUN!
    Bedrijfs MacBook - Krijg de beste laptop om je werk snel en efficiënt te doen!
    Snelle carrièreontwikkeling - Er is geen betere plek om je carrière te ontwikkelen. Wij groeien en jij kunt met ons meegroeien! Interne leiderschapsprogramma’s en coaching.
    Hoge mate van autonomie - Het is tijd om ECHT impact te maken!

Senior Director, International Markets – Europe & UK

Company Description

Butterfly Network, Inc. (NYSE: BFLY) is driving a digital revolution in ultrasound imaging and sensing with its proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor technology and software solutions. Butterfly first proved its technology in the point-of-care ultrasound market – commercializing the world's first single-probe, whole-body portable ultrasound device, which is now on its best-selling, third-generation: Butterfly iQ3™. The Company combines its advanced hardware with cloud software and AI, an enterprise workflow solution (Compass AI™) and other offerings to drive adoption of affordable, accessible ultrasound. Butterfly also enables third-party development of imaging AI apps through Butterfly Garden™, its software development kit and AI partnership initiative. 

In addition to its medical imaging products, Butterfly Embedded™ is the Company's Ultrasound-on-Chip™ licensing and co-development program designed to enable a new wave of ultrasound-enabled technologies across non-competitive healthcare markets and beyond. Through Butterfly Embedded™, partners can build and scale novel ultrasound applications powered by Butterfly's proprietary semiconductor chip and software platform. Butterfly's innovations have been recognized by Prix Galien USA, Fierce 50, TIME's Best Inventions and Fast Company's World Changing Ideas, among other achievements.

We're a team of bold thinkers, problem-solvers, and innovators ready to shape the future of medical imaging. Let's build something extraordinary together!

Job Description

This Senior Director will be a core member of the Butterfly sales growth team, reporting to the VP Global Growth & Customer Success. This leader will own Butterfly's commercial growth outside in Europe leading all sales across Europe and the UK.

A primary focus will be building, scaling, and managing Butterfly's European distribution network. This leader will own the full distributor lifecycle—from market prioritization and partner identification through negotiation, onboarding, launch, sell-through, and ongoing performance management.

Success will be measured by revenue growth and distributor productivity, not simply establishing partnerships. You will ensure partners are positioned to succeed with clear go-to-market plans, training, pipeline and forecasting expectations, marketing support, and performance KPIs. They will maintain a rigorous operating cadence to drive demand, improve performance, and optimize or replace partnerships when needed.

You lead the European team and partner closely with Sales Operations, Marketing, Professional Services, Finance, and Legal to build a repeatable model for entering and scaling international markets.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, highly commercial leader who can open new markets, build high-value distribution partnerships, and turn those partnerships into sustainable revenue growth.

 

Qualifications

Sales & Distribution Leadership

  • 10+ years of Sales Leadership and/or Commercial Leadership experience, with significant experience leading international markets.
  • Demonstrated success building and scaling distributor and channel partner networks across multiple countries or regions.
  • Proven ability to identify, recruit, evaluate, negotiate with, onboard, and launch new distribution partners.
  • Track record of driving measurable sell-through and revenue growth through distributors, beyond simply signing or managing partner agreements.
  • Experience establishing distributor business plans, revenue targets, pipeline expectations, forecasting processes, KPIs, and performance management cadences.
  • Demonstrated ability to enable distributors through sales training, product education, marketing programs, demand generation, and joint customer engagement.
  • Experience managing underperforming distributors, including developing corrective action plans, renegotiating commercial arrangements, and transitioning to new partners when appropriate.
  • Ability to assess new markets and determine the appropriate commercial model, including direct, distributor, or hybrid approaches.
  • Previous healthcare/medical device sales experience, preferably with ultrasound equipment and/or highly transactional medical device sales.
  • 5+ years of field sales experience within the Medical Device industry.
  • Experience selling SaaS or cloud-based enterprise software; EMR and Healthcare IT sales experience preferred.
  • Ability to identify the key aspects of a potential opportunity, nurture opportunities through close, engage channel partners effectively, and manage customer relationships through long-term success.
  • Strong track record of using data, analytics, and commercial insights to make decisions and allocate resources.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 50% internationally, with overnight stays depending on geography and business needs.
  • Excellent verbal, presentation, and written communication skills, with executive presence and experience building C-suite relationships and confidently representing the value and capabilities of Butterfly's products.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms and familiarity with business and analytical tools such as Tableau, Power BI, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Self-driven and highly accountable, with the perseverance to achieve ambitious goals in complex and evolving international markets.
  • Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial, dynamic, and rapidly changing environment

People & Partner Leader

  • Collaborative, team-oriented leadership style with the ability to influence across functions and geographies.
  • Proven track record of hiring, developing, coaching, and retaining high-performing commercial teams.
  • Ability to lead geographically distributed sales teams and effectively escalate and support strategic opportunities.
  • Strong ability to build relationships with distributor owners, executives, sales leaders, and field teams, creating alignment and accountability at multiple levels of a partner organization.
  • Ability to create a high-performance culture across both Butterfly employees and external distribution partners.
  • Skilled at balancing strong partner relationships with clear commercial accountability, including having difficult performance conversations when required.

Language Requirement

Fluency in English is required. (Additional fluency in German is desirable but not a requirement.)

Location

This is a remote position based in The UK, Germany, or The Netherlands with up to 75% travel. 

Benefits and Perks

  • Competitive salaried compensation - we value our employees and show it 
  • Equity - we want every employee to be a stakeholder
  • The opportunity to build a revolutionary healthcare product and save millions of lives! 

 

For this role, we are only considering candidates who are legally authorized to work in either Germany, the UK, or The Netherlands who do not now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status.

Butterfly Network does not accept agency resumes.

Butterfly Network is an E-Verify Company. 

Butterfly Network is an equal opportunity employer.  Regardless of race, traits associated with race, color, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or Veteran status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
